subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should this exact actor-bound protected workflow become crawl-remote’s approved production deployment authority with forward D1 migrations and Worker-only rollback?
rationale: The patch deliberately transfers privileged production ownership and establishes a recovery policy that leaves database migrations applied; those choices require explicit maintainer and operator intent even though the implementation is strongly defended.

options.title: Approve after cutover checks
options.body: Confirm protected-environment controls and companion retirement, then merge fail-closed and perform the dormant production rollout with endpoint, D1, and rollback evidence.

options.title: Revise authority or recovery policy
options.body: Keep the draft open while changing the authorized actor, credential owner, companion sequence, or forward-only database recovery contract.

options.title: Retain service ownership
options.body: Do not complete the transfer if crawl-remote should continue to own its production deployment path.

recommendation.title: Approve after cutover checks
recommendation.body: Confirm protected-environment controls and companion retirement, then merge fail-closed and perform the dormant production rollout with endpoint, D1, and rollback evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They have prior merged ownership of current-main CI and authored the coordinated deployment authority and recovery design.
